title: Random forest on six plasma lipids distinguishes thiopurine-induced leukopenia in IBD
summary: A prospective observational lipidomics study enrolled 127 IBD patients on thiopurines, 27 of whom developed leukopenia, and measured plasma lipids by UHPLC-MS. Univariate and multivariate analysis identified 16 lipid species from four classes (11 triglycerides, 1 sphingomyelin, 1 phosphatidylcholine and 3 lactosylceramides). After machine learning feature reduction, a random forest on six lipids distinguished leukopenia from the normal group, with validation in an independent cohort of 26 leukopenia and 74 non-leukopenia patients. Accuracy values were not visible in the reviewed abstract excerpt.
